analysis.reasonEn: RSI at 26.3 enters extreme oversold territory, with 5 consecutive days of decline. ADX at 21.7 indicates early trend formation, but -DI is stronger than +DI ($15.6 vs $35.6), showing downward pressure. The 5-day low of $1.08 continues the Lower Low pattern. Volume ratio at 1.33x the 5-day average adds conviction to the move.
